upstream.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 340 providers (90+ free), 1200+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 450+ contributors

classification.analysis: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway/proxy that unifies 340+ LLM providers (90+ with free tiers) and 1200+ models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with quota-aware auto-fallback, token-compression (RTK+Caveman, claims 15-95% savings), and MCP/A2A support. It plugs into coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, and Copilot as a drop-in model router, ships as desktop/PWA apps plus a CLI and opencode plugin/provider packages, and is aimed at developers who want to stretch free-tier LLM quotas across many tools.

use_cases.title: Route Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor traffic through free-tier LLM providers
Auto-fallback between 340+ AI providers when one hits a rate limit
Compress prompts to cut token usage 15-95% across agent sessions
Self-host a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for many models
